text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Buena 
Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The sky is... getting cloudy. It might 
start raining soon.
choice_data_list: Shall we hurry on home?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, getting soaked would be terrible. 
Let's go!
choice_data_list: 急いで帰ろうか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we hurry home?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It ended up raining after all. At least 
we managed to find shelter for now.
choice_data_list:
It's probably just a passing shower, so 
let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Huh, really? Thank you!"
choice_data_list: たぶんにわか雨だし、休んでいこう
choice_data_list_en: It's probably just a passing shower, so let's take a break.

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista has disliked the rain ever 
since she was a little girl. And even now, 
that hasn't changed—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And here we had a special outing 
planned, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And here we had a special outing 
planned, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
The road and my clothes are all soaking 
wet... It's so cold, and I feel so 
lonely...
choice_data_list: Are you lonely? ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. But I don't want to. If 
Boo-chan gets wet from the rain or snow, 
he gets all sad and droopy..."
choice_data_list: 寂しい？……どうして？
choice_data_list_en: Lonely? ...Why?

text_block_list.text:
While sheltering from the rain, we 
reminisced. Though it was about when she 
was very young... it seems how she feels 
about the rain hasn't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I still don't really know why... 
I just couldn't control this overwhelming 
feeling of loneliness no matter what.
choice_data_list:
Everyone has things they're not good at, 
so—

text_block_list.text:
I encouraged Buena Vista, telling her she 
didn't need to force herself to overcome 
it, hoping to lighten her load.
choice_data_list: 誰にでも苦手なものはあるから――
choice_data_list_en: Everyone has things they're not good at, soâ

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but is your work okay? You probably 
have things to do back at the office, so 
maybe we really should head back.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm all grown up now, so getting a little 
wet won't hurt me at all!

"Indeed, there's plenty to do. I want to 
analyze the data on our upcoming races and 
tailor training routines to match."
choice_data_list:
Still, we've got enough leeway to wait for 
rain.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're as kind as ever. But that's exactly 
why I want to change!
choice_data_list: でも、雨を待つくらいの余裕はあるよ
choice_data_list_en: But we can afford to wait for the rain.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best to overcome it 
someday, so that getting soaked by rain or 
snow won't bother me at all—
Oh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see, I totally get it. Lots of girls get 
all sentimental on rainy days!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'm totally hunky-dory even in 
the rain, but... sometimes I remember 
those lonely days and feel a little 
wistful.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? You too, Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but you know, there's a saying: 
"After the rain comes bright sunshine!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if something totally bogus happens, 
it'll lead to a nice future!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because no rain lasts forever. Besides, 
if you think back really carefully, there 
must have been plenty of wonderful 
memories, too."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I feel so lonely...
choice_data_list:
If you're lonely... I'll always stay by 
your side.

If you're lonely... I'll always stay by 
your side.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Brother did...?
choice_data_list: 寂しいなら……俺がずっとそばにいるよ
寂しいなら……私がずっとそばにいるよ
choice_data_list_en: If you're lonely... I'll always be by your side.
If you're lonely... I'll always be by your side.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Sister did...?
choice_data_list: ブエナが寂しくなくなるまで、一緒にいる
choice_data_list_en: I'll stay with you until you're not lonely anymore, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Really...?
choice_data_list: ブエナが寂しくなくなるまで、一緒にいる
choice_data_list_en: I'll stay with you until you're not lonely anymore, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Until the rain stops... will you stay by 
Bu-chan's side?
choice_data_list: Ah, it's a promise!
Yeah, it's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's certainly true. It wasn't 
just painful memories...
choice_data_list: ああ、約束だ！
うん、約束だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, it's a promise!
Yeah, it's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother made me... such a kind 
promise. So why did I end up forgetting 
it?"
choice_data_list:
It kept raining for a while after that, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister made... a sweet promise with 
me. So why did I end up forgetting it?
choice_data_list: あの後もしばらく、雨が続いてたからなぁ
choice_data_list_en: The rain kept up for a while after that, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Ugh, maybe my lonely feelings 
just got the better of me... Sorry.
choice_data_list: あの後もしばらく、雨が続いてたからなぁ
choice_data_list_en: The rain kept up for a while after that, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Looks like the rain has stopped. 
Maybe I should head home with Tacchan too!
choice_data_list: Maruzensky, I have a favor to ask!
Shall we head back, Buena!

text_block_list.text:
Judging by the weather forecast website 
checked on my smartphone, even if it's 
clear now, there's no telling when it 
might start raining again. So—
choice_data_list: マルゼンスキー、ひとつお願いが！
帰ろうか、ブエナ！
choice_data_list_en: Maruzensky, I have a favor to ask!
Shall we head back, Buena!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh!?
choice_data_list: ブエナも一緒に送っていってくれないか？
ブエナも一緒に送っていってくれない？
choice_data_list_en: Could you walk Buena back with me?
Could you walk Buena back with me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"All right, leave it to me☆ Buena-chan, 
shouldn't we take into account his 
feelings for you?"
choice_data_list: また降るかもしれないし……お願い！
choice_data_list_en: It might start raining again... please!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"All right, leave it to me☆ Buena-chan, 
shouldn't we take into account her 
feelings for you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...See ya. Um... Trainer, you take care 
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Buena-chan. ...What a wonderful 
childhood friend he is."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Buena-chan. ...What a wonderful 
childhood friend she is."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That person always gives me 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, thanks to Maruzen-san's story, I 
think I might be able to push through 
rainy days... just a little better than 
before."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu! A hunky-dory ending, isn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu. You two get along so well, it's 
wonderful. Well then, I shall take my 
leave first.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for today. Please get 
home safe!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, ba-bye☆

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...The sky after the rain is so pretty, 
isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we could go out today.
choice_data_list: ああ
うん
choice_data_list_en: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Being able to talk with Maruzen-san and 
remember our old promise—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even on rainy days, maybe now... I won't 
feel quite as lonely as before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The promise we made that rainy day... This 
time, I'll never ever forget it.
